title: webhook-batch-node
blurb: A Node.js webhook batcher mixes tenants, misses the size boundary, and loses failed deliveries before retry.
brief:
A dependency-free Node.js service batches webhook events per tenant. Production found cross-tenant deliveries, batches that grow one event beyond their configured maximum, and event loss whenever the sender throws.

Read the built-in `node:test` contract before editing `src/batcher.js`. Preserve per-tenant input order and do not hide delivery failures.

**Your job:** isolate queues by tenant, flush at the exact boundary, and remove events only after successful delivery.
